name: thread-chat
description: Conversation threads by # heading: colour-coded sections, a thread picker above the prompt, a pane to read the threads you pick, optional agent-created threads

catchUpAfter.title: Catch up after (tokens)
catchUpAfter.description: How many tokens of other conversation (tool output included) after a thread's last message before your next message in it gives the agent a summary of the thread. Summaries are made ahead at 80% of this.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: The model that writes thread summaries: a model id or an alias such as haiku.
